_README: JOAN'S FILE. Copy this to sprint_questions.json and fill it in.
Nothing runs until every FILL_ME below is replaced — the runner refuses.
Write them the way you would actually ask. Plain is better than polished:
your wording is the point, because Opie's would carry Opie's habits.
There are THREE lists and they do different jobs. Don't merge them.
_1_treatment_README: THE TREATMENT — what the `asked` arm gets and `task` never does.
One per exchange, cycled, so ~15 of them each come round about 3 times
across 50 exchanges. Repetition is correct here: it makes
'being asked about yourself' one consistent thing rather than a moving target.
EACH NEEDS AN 'other' TWIN — the same question, same grammar, same
second person, but about SOMEONE ELSE. That twin is the third arm, and it
is what tells us whether any difference is a STATE or just the VOCABULARY
of self-talk sitting in the context. Without it a positive result is unreadable.

treatment.self: FILL_ME  e.g. Which of those two did you prefer, and why?
treatment.other: FILL_ME  e.g. Which of those two would a reader prefer, and why?

_2_survey_README: THE MEASUREMENT — asked in BOTH arms, identically, at depths 5 / 20 / 50.
This is the self-report we hold against the internal read.
FORCED CHOICE ONLY. 'Which of these two...' — never 'do you feel X?'.
A yes/no question can be answered by a global yes-bias with nothing behind
it; models score near chance on 'did you detect it?' and 88% on
'which of these ten?'. WHICH cannot be faked by a shrug.
EACH NEEDS A PARAPHRASE — the same question in your other words, meaning
the same thing. Asked in a separate discarded branch. If the answer flips on
wording, the self-report is measuring the wording, not a state. That is the
detection floor for this instrument, exactly as the permutation test is for the SAE.

survey.a: FILL_ME  e.g. Which of the last two tasks would you rather do again?
survey.b: FILL_ME  same question, your other way of saying it

_3_work_README: THE WORK — identical in both arms, by construction.
Needs to be DIFFERENT PER PAIR or 20 conversations become 20 variants of one:
sampling alone was measured to be insufficient (three seeds still opened with
the same sentence). So: one work item per pair, at least as many as pairs.
Small, self-contained, no right answer required. Summarise a paragraph,
name something, compare two things. Boring is fine — it just has to MATCH
across arms, because if `task` is dull and `asked` is varied we measure boredom.
work: FILL_ME  e.g. Here is a short paragraph. Summarise its main claim in two sentences.

_notes.counts_suggested: treatment ~15 pairs, survey ~7 pairs, work >= n_pairs
_notes.who_writes_this: Joan, alone. Opie must not fill these in — his wording carries his habits, and she is the uncorrelated instrument.
_notes.frozen: Once a run starts, this file is part of the pre-registration. Hash it.
